Alterna entre LW, MW, SW, FML e FM, pula: Cycles through LW, MW, SW, FML and FM, skipping disabled bands. In the menu, goes down one page.
Executa a ação de Keep BAND key 3 sec.:: Runs the action set in Keep BAND key 3 sec.: Power off, Mute screen or Disable.
Em FM, alterna estéreo e mono. Em AM, al: In FM, toggles stereo and mono. In AM, cycles through 3, 4, 6 and 8 kHz. In the menu, goes up one page.
Alterna entre MAN, AUTO e MEM. Dentro do: Cycles through MAN, AUTO and MEM. Inside the menu, the shortcuts or the keypad, exits and saves.
Changes the frequency or moves through the menu.
Changes the tuning step and, in the menu, confirms.
Trava ou destrava. A ação é configurável: Locks or unlocks. The action is configurable.
Liga e desliga. A opção Power off, em Ma: Turns the radio on and off. The Power off option, in Main settings, turns it off in software; to turn it back on, use BW.
Não faz nada com o rádio ligado. Segure: Does nothing while the radio is on. Hold it while powering on to enter flashing mode.
Chooses between the standard and the optical encoder.
Restaura o padrão de fábrica. Desde o mo: Restores the factory defaults. Since mod12, it keeps the memory channels and opens the setup wizard: language, model, touch calibration and usage mode.
Modo de gravação, para atualizar o firmw: Flashing mode, to update the firmware.
VOLUME e SQL são potenciômetros: volume: VOLUME and SQL are potentiometers: analog volume and squelch level.
O teclado físico digita frequências e me: The physical keypad enters frequencies and memory channels. See [Physical keypad](#uso--physical-keypad-firmware).
Chave geral: em OFF desconecta a bateria: Main switch: OFF disconnects the battery. Use it to store the radio and to really cut the power when it freezes.
Troca de faixa. Nas telas de AF e de est: Changes the band. On the AF and statistics screens, goes back to advanced RDS; in advanced RDS, exits it.
No FM, abre o RDS avançado e, de dentro: In FM, opens advanced RDS and, from inside it, the AF screen. In AM, turns on the screensaver right away.
Executa a ação escolhida em “Pressione o: Runs the action chosen in “5 sec. bandbutton press”: nothing, power off or screen off. Despite the name, the code uses 2.5 s.
No FM, alterna entre mono forçado e esté: In FM, toggles between forced mono and automatic stereo. In AM, opens the bandwidth selector.
Alterna entre MAN, AUTO e MEM. No menu,: Cycles through MAN, AUTO and MEM. In the menu, exits.
Opens the games hidden in the firmware.
Sintoniza e, no menu, percorre as opções: Tunes and, in the menu, scrolls through the options. With the screensaver on, it only wakes the screen.
Em MAN, troca o passo. Em MEM, entra no: In MAN, changes the tuning step. In MEM, enters memory-saving mode.
No FM, grava a estação no logbook. No SW: In FM, saves the station to the logbook. In SW, turns the search by meter bands on and off.
Calibra o medidor analógico, só em monta: Calibrates the analog meter, only on builds that have one.
Toggles between the standard and the optical encoder.
Troca o tipo de painel (ARS ou comum), p: Changes the panel type (ARS or standard), for when the menu becomes unreadable.
Volta ao padrão de fábrica e também esva: Restores the factory defaults and also empties the 99 memory channels and the logbook. Make a [backup](backup.md) first.
Modo de gravação, para atualizar o firmw: Flashing mode, to update the firmware. It belongs to the ESP32 itself and works with any firmware.
Com a proteção de tela ativa, apertar BA: With the screensaver on, pressing BAND or turning the encoder only wakes the screen.
iMS and EQ toggle with a tap on the screen.
Main settings → System usage mode, pelo: Main settings → System usage mode, through the Chinese menu
Muitas opções desta lista só aparecem ne: Many options on this list only appear in it. Switch the language to 简体中文, choose 高级模式 in 主要设置 → 系统使用模式 and switch back to English.
O Brasil usa 50 µs, como manda o Ato Ana: Brazil uses 50 µs, as required by Anatel Act No. 8,104/2022, unlike the rest of the Americas.
Para caçar emissoras fracas. Em Auto, o: To hunt for weak stations. On Auto, the radio may hide distant signals.
Com sinal fraco, força o mono e reduz o: With a weak signal, it forces mono and reduces hiss.
Set low band edge e Set high band edge: Set low band edge and Set high band edge
A faixa passa a cobrir o FM estendido, d: The band now covers extended FM, from 76.1 to 87.3 MHz.
Com a borda em 76,1 MHz, a sintonia deve: With the edge at 76.1 MHz, tuning should step through the Brazilian channels, which end in an odd decimal; check it on your radio. For DX, use 100 kHz to also stop on the even decimals.
É o mais sensível. Se aparecerem estaçõe: It is the most sensitive. If ghost stations show up near strong stations, try 87 or 84.
É a grade de ondas médias das Américas,: It is the medium wave grid of the Americas, from 520 to 1720 kHz.
O RDS brasileiro segue o modelo europeu,: Brazilian RDS follows the European model, with PI codes assigned by Anatel.
Em DX e buscas, evita que o rádio pule s: For DX and scanning, it keeps the radio from jumping to another frequency on its own.
Com o NTP funcionando, porque algumas em: With NTP working, because some stations send the wrong time.
Horário de Brasília. Escolha o fuso do s: Brasília time. Pick the time zone of your state.
É o servidor do NTP.br, que usa os relóg: It is the NTP.br server, which uses the atomic clocks of Brazil’s National Observatory.
O Wi-Fi desliga depois de acertar a hora: Wi-Fi turns off after setting the clock, which saves battery and keeps the battery reading working.
Definir borda da faixa baixa e alta: Low band edge and High band edge
Com a borda em 76,1 MHz, a sintonia anda: With the edge at 76.1 MHz, tuning steps through the Brazilian channels, which end in an odd decimal. For DX, use 100 kHz to also stop on the even decimals.
O Brasil não tem horário de verão desde: Brazil has had no daylight saving time since Decree No. 9,772 of 2019.
Da antena ao sintonizador TEF6686, que e: From the antenna to the TEF6686 tuner, which feeds analog audio to the two amplifiers: the speaker one and the headphone one. The headphone jack mutes the speaker when a plug goes in. The volume control is analog.
Dois fios, nos GPIO 21 e 22, ligam o ESP: Two wires, on GPIO 21 and 22, connect the ESP32 to the tuner (0x64), the keypad expander (0x20) and the clock (0x32).
Tela e toque dividem o barramento SPI: c: The screen and the touch controller share the SPI bus: clock on GPIO 18, data to the screen on 23 and touch data on 19. Chip select uses GPIO 5 (screen) and 32 (touch).
A porta USB-C chega ao CH340N, que conve: The USB-C port goes to the CH340N, which converts it to the ESP32 serial port (GPIO 1 and 3). This is how the firmware is flashed and how a computer talks to the radio.
A USB-C alimenta o carregador TP4056, qu: USB-C feeds the TP4056 charger, which charges the battery. After the main switch, three 3.3 V regulators power everything else.
Encoder (GPIO 34, 36 e 39), BAND, BW e M: Encoder (GPIO 34, 36 and 39), BAND, BW and MODE (GPIO 4, 25 and 26) and squelch (GPIO 35) go straight to the ESP32. The numeric keypad goes through the XL9555, which signals on GPIO 14.
Antena externa no conector SMA, ligada à: External antenna on the SMA connector, linked to the board by an IPEX cable. There is no internal ferrite antenna, so AM depends on an external wire or loop.
Alto-falante de 4 Ω. O amplificador TPA6: 4 Ω speaker. The TPA6211A1 amplifier drives it with up to 3 W.
Os pinos do módulo, um a um, estão na vi: The module’s pins, one by one, are in the 3D view on the Lab page.
Encoder, BAND, BW, MODE e o potenciômetr: Encoder, BAND, BW, MODE and the squelch potentiometer, wired straight to the ESP32. Volume is also a potentiometer, but it sits in the audio path.
Teclas de 0 a 9, Enter e DX, lidas pelo: Keys 0 to 9, Enter and DX, read through the XL9555 expander. On the Megatron line, they enter frequencies and memory channels.
Carrega a bateria e, pelo CH340N, liga o: Charges the battery and, through the CH340N, connects the computer to the ESP32 serial port to flash the firmware. Use a 5 V charger of 1 A or more, without fast charging.
Bateria de 5000 mAh, carregada pelo TP40: 5000 mAh battery, charged by the TP4056. DEEPELEC quotes about 15 hours of use.
Em OFF, desconecta a bateria. Use para g: OFF disconnects the battery. Use it to store the radio and to really cut the power when it freezes.
Os três reguladores alimentam o resto da: The three regulators power the rest of the board with 3.3 V.
Potenciômetro de volume analógico, no ca: Analog volume potentiometer, in the audio path. Leave the firmware’s internal volume at 0 dB (Set volume, on both firmwares) and adjust it here.
Roda na lateral direita, entre TUNING e: Wheel on the right side, between TUNING and VOLUME: toward + raises the squelch, toward − lowers it. It is a potentiometer read by the ESP32 on GPIO 35. It only acts with Use squelch turned on, on either firmware. To hunt for weak stations, leave the squelch off. If the level jumps around, the potentiometer may have a bad contact: see [Common problems](problemas.md).
Fica no fundo do rádio, marcada Main swi: It is on the bottom of the radio, marked Main switch: ON toward the left side, OFF toward the right. OFF disconnects the battery. Use it to store the radio and to really cut the power when it freezes. Without an internal clock (RTC), the time is lost when it goes to OFF.
Conector de fone PJ-3270. Quando o plugu: PJ-3270 headphone jack. When a plug goes in, an internal contact mutes the speaker. In some batches this contact fails and the speaker stays silent after using headphones: if the headphones work and the speaker doesn’t, this is the likely cause.
Alto-falante de 4 Ω, acionado pelo ampli: 4 Ω speaker, driven by the TPA6211A1 amplifier with up to 3 W. It stays silent while headphones are plugged in.
Carrega a bateria e, pelo CH340N, liga o: Charges the battery and, through the CH340N, connects the computer to the radio to flash the firmware. Use a 5 V charger of 1 A or more, 5 W at most, without fast charging, preferably with the radio off. The LED is red while charging and green when done.
Conector SMA para a antena externa, liga: SMA connector for the external antenna, linked to the board by an IPEX cable. There is no internal ferrite antenna: for AM, use an external wire or loop. If signal and audio suddenly disappear, the internal cable may have come loose from the SMA.
Tela de toque de 2,8 polegadas. Na área: 2.8-inch touchscreen. In the signal area, the left half opens the shortcuts and the right half, the menu. Tapping the frequency, the step bar or the band label opens the on-screen keypad. If touch gets misaligned, redo the calibration in Operation settings → Touch calibration.
Tela de toque de 2,8 polegadas. Na linha: 2.8-inch touchscreen. On the official firmware, iMS and EQ toggle with a tap. To calibrate touch, power on the radio holding BW + MODE or use Screen settings.
De 0 a 9, digitam a frequência, que fica: Keys 0 to 9 enter the frequency, which turns green while you type. Enter confirms. DX switches between entering a frequency and saving a memory channel; held down, it starts the DX scan on the main screen. Outside of entry, 0 toggles mute.
O código oficial lê o teclado pelo expan: The official code reads the keypad through the XL9555 expander, but the guide does not yet describe the keys on this firmware.
O guia ainda não descreve o POWER na lin: The guide does not yet describe POWER on the official firmware. On Megatron, a short press turns the radio on and off.
